title: Marcos, Japan PM Takaichi hold phone talks ahead of Asean Summit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi held a telephone conversation on Tuesday ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits to reaffirm their commitment to strengthening bilateral relations and advancing regional cooperation. In a press release, the Presidential Communications Office said the two leaders discussed preparations for the summits in November, which will bring together Asean leaders and dialogue partners. Marcos and Takaichi also discussed the 4th Asia Zero Emission Community (AZEC) Leaders’ Meeting, which the Philippines and Japan are scheduled to co-chair next month. READ: PH, Japan relations elevated to ‘Comprehensive Strategic Partnership’ AZEC is a Japan-led initiative aimed at promoting clean energy, reducing carbon emissions, and supporting sustainable economic growth while strengthening energy security across the region.
